stations.title: Wilf
stations.note: In the depot, at the screen.

stations.title: Tram tracker
stations.text: Radios the depot at every stop on the line.

captions: In the depot, Wilf wants a screen that shows where a tram on the line is right now.
The trams radio every stop, and the screen just says it is waiting, all day long.
You keep the screen in step with the tracker using effects, in four tasks.
Tram 14 reaches a stop and the screen says so, with the stops it still has to go.
Same tracker, now someone listens. Pick another tram and the screen follows it.
